name: Sacred Shiva Lingam (Shivling)
description: Intricately detailed Shiva Lingam featuring a multi-hooded Naga serpent canopy, ornamental yoni base with directional spout, decorative lotus floral motifs, and a central Om (ॐ) medallion. Designed as an authentic spiritual centerpiece for your home, pooja mandir, or temple décor.
shortDescription: Intricate Naga serpent canopy, lotus base & Om medallion

name: Cute Stanley Cup Clicker Keychain
description: Ultra-satisfying tactile mechanical clicker styled as a miniature Stanley tumbler complete with handle and straw. Push the straw for a crisp, responsive mechanical click. Available in pastel pink, vivid orange, and royal purple with smooth keychain hardware.
shortDescription: Tactile mechanical clicker with straw & handle

name: Ornate Elephant Tealight Candle Holder
description: Intricately carved Indian royal elephant featuring traditional ornamental saddle detailing and a lotus-inspired tealight holder nestled on its back. Creates a warm festive glow for Diwali, spiritual spaces, and dining tables. Available in Royal Purple, Antique Slate, and Silk Gold.
shortDescription: Ornate ceremonial elephant with lotus tealight cradle

name: Wavy Retro Optical Lamp with Tripod
description: Mid-century modern wavy basket lamp paired with an architectural tripod base. The specialized micro-textured diffuser gently scatters warm LED light with zero harsh glare, creating an inviting ambient atmosphere on bedside tables and credenzas.
shortDescription: Sculptural textured wavy diffuser with tripod base

name: Ayodhya Ram Mandir Architectural Prototype
description: Exquisitely detailed architectural scale model of the Ayodhya Ram Mandir. Accurately captures the multi-tiered shikharas, central dome, pillared mandapas, ornamental jali carvings, and towering flag spire in shimmering silk filament.
shortDescription: Scale replica with tiered shikharas & carved columns

name: Low-Poly Geometric Lion Statue
description: Contemporary faceted geometric lion figurine with a confident, proud posture. Its sharp polygonal planes catch natural room lighting dynamically, making it a bold modern statement piece for executive desks, bookshelves, and entryways.
shortDescription: Modern faceted polygonal lion for desk & shelf decor

name: Smart NFC Multi-Link Business Display Station
description: Professional contactless tap-to-connect business station. Embedded with NTAG215 NFC chips that instantly open your Google Reviews, Instagram profile, website, or digital payment page with a quick tap of any smartphone. Includes an integrated card holder slot and custom logo medallion.
shortDescription: Instant phone tap for Google Reviews, Instagram & cards

name: Ice Cream Cone Clicker Keychain
description: Delightful soft-serve swirl ice cream cone with cross-hatched waffle cone texture and a hidden internal mechanical switch. Press the swirl top for a crisp, tactile click that helps maintain focus and relieves daily stress.
shortDescription: Pocket-sized textured waffle cone with crisp click action

name: James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) Scale Model
description: Precision engineering prototype of humanity's premier deep-space observatory. Featuring the distinctive 18 hexagonal primary mirror segments in deep gold, multi-layer silver sunshield, instrument payload module, and articulated mast.

name: Modern Dual Spiral Swirl Table Lamp
description: Elegant helical twist lamps crafted in contrasting colorways (Emerald Green / White and Tangerine / Cream). The spiral ribs cast dramatic swirling shadow gradients on surrounding walls when illuminated.
shortDescription: Helical spiral diffuser casting geometric ambient light

name: Kumiko Japanese Cylindrical Lattice Lamp
description: Inspired by sacred Asanoha (hemp leaf) Japanese Kumiko woodworking. The dense geometric lattice allows gentle inner light diffusion, creating tranquil patterns across your meditation space or bedroom.
shortDescription: Sacred Asanoha geometric lattice with ambient core

name: Custom 3D Printed Business Desk Nameplate
description: Tailor-made freestanding executive nameplate with high-relief 3D typography, chamfered letters, and a weighted oval foundation. Customised with your company name, brand fonts, or personal title.
shortDescription: Personalised 3D lettering with weighted display base

name: Shubh Labh & Om Spiritual Wall Decor Set
description: Traditional शुभ (Shubh) and लाभ (Labh) sacred lettering bordered with delicate lotus flowers and accompanied by an ornamental Om medallion. Designed to be lightweight and effortlessly wall-mounted using double-sided tape for entrance doorways, mandirs, and Diwali celebrations.
shortDescription: Traditional शुभ & लाभ lettering with sacred lotus motifs

name: Ergonomic Headphone Stand & Tablet Dock
description: Minimalist architectural headphone cradle with ribbed acoustic dampening curves, paired with a universal tablet / iPad stand featuring an integrated Apple Pencil slot and organizer tray.
shortDescription: Fluted headphone perch with accessory tray
